#!/usr/bin/env bash
violation=0
while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        trimmed=$(echo "$line" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//')
        if [[ $trimmed == \#* ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        if [[ $line =~ uses:[[:space:]] ]]; then
            value=${line#*uses:}
            value=$(echo "$value" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]#].*//' -e "s/['\"]//g")
            if [[ -z $value ]]; then
                continue
            fi
            if [[ $value == .* ]] || [[ $value == ./]* ]]; then
                continue
            fi
            if [[ $value == *@* ]]; then
                ref=${value#*@}
            else
                ref=""
            fi
            if [[ -z $ref ]]; then
                violation=1
                break 2
            fi
            if ! [[ $ref =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$ ]]; then
                violation=1
                break 2
            fi
        fi
    done < "$file"
    if [[ $violation -ne 0 ]]; then
        break
    fi
done < <(find .github/workflows -type f \( -name "*.yml" -o -name "*.yaml" \) -print0 2>/dev/null)
if [[ $violation -ne 0 ]]; then
    exit 1
else
    exit 0
fi
